eligibility.description: Your solar PV system must be net metered and must not be receiving a government funded feed-in tariff.

singleRate.description: Total of 13 hours at specified intervals and times one day.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 2.25 cents/kWh 50% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources
For 4.50 cents/kWh 100% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources

solarFeedInTariff.description: Origin offers 10 cents per kWh until a daily export limit of 8 kWh is reached. The daily export limit is averaged across your billing period (calculated by multiplying the number of days in your billing period by your daily export limit of 8 kWh)  All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any).. All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any). All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any).
For any amount above the daily export, you will receive our standard retailer feed-in tariff of 5 cents per KWh All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any).

c.additionalFeeInformation: You may be required to pay any amounts that a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including any metering-related goods or services, and which are not already incorporated into the Supply Charges or Energy Usage Charges. You can find out more at www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges

fees.description: A $117.54 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $52.20 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of up to $230.41 (GST Incl) may apply when your property is disconnected for non-payment. Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
$2.15 (incl GST) may apply for each paper bill.
